facts.business: Super Sales India Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of textile machinery and related components, and also generates wind energy.

capacity_or_capex.item: Property, plant and equipment (Net of advances)

key_risks: Uncertain tax positions related to disputed electricity generation tax of Rs.371.05 lakhs
Recoverability of income tax assets and receivables from government authorities
facts.related_party_note: The company has extensive related party transactions with entities under the Lakshmi group including LMW Limited (formerly Lakshmi Machine Works Limited), Lakshmi Electrical Control Systems Limited, Lakshmi Precision Technologies Limited, and numerous other private limited companies. A resolution is proposed for approval of transactions with LMW Limited up to Rs.200 Crores for the period from the conclusion of the 44th AGM till the conclusion of the next AGM.
